title: Unary-index encodings are valid
statement: Let $p$ be a predicate on pairs of natural numbers, and let $y$ be a bit string. If there are natural numbers $n$ and $i$ such that $y$ is the pairing of the length-$n$ all-ones string with the binary expansion of $i$, and $p(n,i)$ holds, then $y$ is a valid plain encoding.
hypotheses_covered: p is a predicate on natural-number pairs
y belongs to the set of encodings of the length-n all-ones string paired with the binary expansion of i for some n,i satisfying p(n,i)
